guide.title: National Association guide
guide.activationText: A National Association becomes active when it has at least five eligible managers and the shared one-time 50-Coin founding requirement is complete. Contributions never create ownership or extra voting power.
guide.electionsText: Active members elect the National Coach. Candidate registration, voting and any runoffs are handled in the Elections tab. Every active member has one vote per round.
guide.selectionText: The National Coach sends call-ups, confirms a 10-rider squad and selects seven riders for each race day. Riders must accept their call-up before they can be selected.
guide.packageText: Every National Association receives the same system-covered equipment, race assets and supplies. The National Coach can save three equipment sets and National Team resources do not deplete.
guide.worldNationsText: Active National Associations enter World Nations competition according to the season schedule. Qualification groups, race days, results and advancement are shown in the World Nations Championship tab.
guide.chatHistoryText: Association members share a private Team Chat. The History tab keeps the permanent record of activation, membership, elections, coaches, squads, champions and World Nations results.

electionsPage.phase1Help: Eligible members register as candidates and publish a manifesto.
electionsPage.phase2Help: Every active member receives one final vote for the round.
electionsPage.phase3Help: Tied leaders continue into seven-day runoff rounds until there is a unique winner.
electionsPage.principle1: Every active Association member has exactly one vote per election round.
electionsPage.principle2: Activation contributions never create extra votes, ownership or governance rights.
electionsPage.principle3: The National Coach is elected by members and does not receive an automatic rider place in the squad.
electionsPage.principle4: If the vote is tied, only the tied leaders continue to the next runoff round.

e2e.title: World Nations E2E stresna provjera
e2e.description: Test ugovora samo za čitanje za cijelu Nations arhitekturu. Provjerava kvalifikacijsku piramidu, siječanjske izbore, fiksni paket reprezentacije, maskirani Overall, ravnotežu bodovanja, pravila postava, puna polja utrka, obavijesti i automatsko održavanje bez stvaranja lažnih živih Saveza.

fixture.title: Rollback test životnog ciklusa
fixture.description: Pokreće sintetički World Nations ciklus s privremenim korisnicima, pet kvalificiranih menadžera po Savezu, pravim generatorom izdanja, rasporedom, ždrijebom, izborom domaćina, blokadom postava, napredovanjem, zapisima prvaka/povijesti i obavijestima. Sve se odvija unutar rollback podtransakcije i provjerava da ne ostanu sintetički korisnici ili Savezi.
fixture.safety: Sigurnosno pravilo: poslužitelj odbija test kada postoje stvarni Nacionalni savezi ili izdanje Nations tekuće sezone. Provjera samo za čitanje ostaje dostupna.
